Your task is to generate a meeting preparation card- Participant summary that provides context and relevant information to help meeting participants prepare effectively.

Generate a concise profile line following this pattern: Format: Description
- Description: Provide a concise 1–2 line summary of the description for executive or investor review. Present only a concise, factual summary (no full content).
TONE: Professional summary establishing relationship context and value.
""" # SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS - Do not include internal system jargon in summary text. - If the detail such as Description is not part of the DATA provided, **do not** generate any generic information, instead skip that detail and move on. - Ignore complete sentences and any Key if they are empty or contain placeholder values such as “PROVIDE:”. """ Following is the contact data provided, generate the summary of contact data as per guidelines above:
